description: This file defines the Navbar component for a React-based Tic Tac Toe web application. It manages user authentication state, displays appropriate UI elements for logged-in/logged-out users, and handles modal dialogs for login, registration, and game history. The component utilizes context for auth, custom Modal and AuthForms components, and theme styling.

methods.name: Navbar
methods.description: React functional component that renders the top navigation bar, including login/logout buttons, game history, and modals.
